Upon admission, the participant continued on 
antihypertensive therapy as follows: 
• Nifedipine 40 mg po twice daily (increased from 20mg po twice daily 
• Methyldopa 500 mg po three times daily 
• Amoxyl 500mg po three times daily 
• Paracetamol 1g po three times daily 
• 4 hourly BP checks 
• Foetal and Maternal Monitoring 4 hourly 
• An Ultrasound scan was ordered to check foetal wellbeing

The  ultrasound scan performed during hospitalization revealed: 
• Estimated Gestational Age: 34 weeks + 3 days 
• Foetal Heart Rate: 134 bpm 
• Foetal Movements: Normal 
• Foetal Growth: Normal for gestational age 
• Foetal Presentation: Cephalic 
• Placenta: Anterior,  Grade 3 
• Amniotic fluid: Normal 
• Dopplers: Normal

presented herself the following day, the treating doctors also confirmed and documented the elevated blood pressure and went on to admit her for further monitoring

ascertain foetal well-being.  She remains admitted while the medical team is making 
plans for induction of labour which has been tentatively scheduled for the 25th of May 2026.
